basis: The visually checked 1887 Welland history, printed p.559 (IA leaf 573), identifies Sinclair Holden Glasgow as William’s son, names William’s wife Mary Elizabeth Lundy, describes William’s Stamford farm, Norfolk interval and justice-of-the-peace office, and explicitly calls Rev. William was reported alive, aged 61, when the account appeared.

It does not identify the minister with an existing numbered Samuel profile, validate the reported ministry/Irish migration from independent records, or prove the city-name and Douglas romance printed beside it. The compatible Niagara farmer in LAC MG24-I39 is an unselected identity comparison: the eight-page transcripts and the underlying war-loss claim were not inspected. Samuel’s wife and parents remain unknown. No live WikiTree save or new profile creation.
